subjects.name: Artificial Intelligence
subjects.textbook: Stuart Russell and Peter Norvig, Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (3rd edition)
subjects.description: Comprehensive study of rational agents, search techniques, adversarial search, constraint satisfaction, first-order logical reasoning, and machine learning fundamentals.

modules.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
modules.description: Foundations, history, applications of AI, and structure of rational agents and environments.

topics.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
topics.description: Core overview of artificial intelligence and artificial intelligence definitions.

topics.title: What is Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
topics.description: Thinking humanly, thinking rationally, acting humanly (Turing test), and acting rationally.

topics.title: Foundations of AI
topics.description: Contributions of philosophy, mathematics, economics, neuroscience, psychology, computer engineering, control theory, and linguistics.

topics.title: History of Artificial Intelligence
topics.description: Gestation of AI (1943-1955), birth of AI (Dartmouth 1956), early enthusiasm, reality checks, knowledge-based systems, AI winter, and AI resurgence.

topics.title: Applications of Artificial Intelligence
topics.description: Robotic vehicles, speech recognition, autonomous planning and scheduling, game playing, spam fighting, logistics planning, machine translation.

topics.title: Intelligent Agents
topics.description: Architectural foundation of agents, rationality, environment classifications, and agent structures.

subtopics.title: Agents and environments
Good behaviour of agents
Concept of rationality
Rational agents
Nature of environments (PEAS & environment properties: observable, deterministic, episodic, static, discrete, single-agent)
Structure of agents (Simple reflex, Model-based reflex, Goal-based, Utility-based, Learning agents)

modules.title: Problem Solving by Searching
modules.description: Problem-solving agents, state spaces, uninformed search strategies, informed search (heuristic algorithms), and admissible heuristics.

topics.title: Solving problems by searching
topics.description: Formulating problems and searching for solution paths in state space.

topics.title: Problem-solving agents
topics.description: Goal formulation, problem formulation, search, and execution phase.

topics.title: Example problems
topics.description: Toy problems (8-puzzle, 8-queens, vacuum world) and real-world problems (route finding, touring, VLSI layout, robot navigation).

topics.title: Illustration of the problem-solving process by agents
topics.description: Initial state, actions, transition model, goal test, path cost.

topics.title: Searching for solutions
topics.description: Search tree generation, node expansion, looping paths, redundant paths, graph search vs tree search.

topics.title: Uninformed search strategies
topics.description: Classic blind search strategies with time/space complexity analysis, completeness, and optimality.

subtopics.title: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
Uniform-Cost Search (UCS)
Depth-First Search (DFS)
Depth-Limited Search (DLS)
Iterative Deepening Depth-First Search (IDDFS)

topics.title: Informed search strategies
topics.description: Heuristic-guided evaluation functions f(n) and optimal search.

subtopics.title: Best-First Search (Greedy Best-First)
A* Search (Algorithm, optimality proof, admissibility, consistency)

topics.title: Heuristic functions
topics.description: Effect of heuristic accuracy, generating admissible heuristics from relaxed problems, pattern databases, dominance.

modules.title: Search in Complex Environments
modules.description: Adversarial games, optimal game decisions, Minimax, Alpha-Beta pruning, and Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSPs).

topics.title: Adversarial Search
topics.description: Game theory and competitive environments.

subtopics.title: Games (Deterministic, turn-taking, zero-sum, perfect information games)
Optimal decisions in games
Minimax algorithm (Tree evaluation, pseudocode, time & space complexity)
Alpha-Beta Pruning (Mathematical conditions, pruning effectiveness, order of node visits)

topics.title: Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSP)
topics.description: Variables, domains, and constraints with propagation and backtracking.

subtopics.title: Defining CSP (Variables X, Domains D, Constraints C; Map coloring, Cryptarithmetic)
Constraint propagation (Node consistency, Arc consistency AC-3, Path consistency)
Inference in CSPs (Forward checking and constraint propagation)
Backtracking search for CSPs (MRV heuristic, Degree heuristic, Least Constraining Value)
Structure of CSP problems (Independent subproblems, Tree-structured CSPs, Cutset conditioning)

modules.title: Knowledge Representation and Reasoning
modules.description: Logical agents, Propositional Logic theorem proving, First-Order Logic syntax/semantics, Unification, Forward/Backward chaining, and Resolution.

topics.title: Logical Agents
topics.description: Knowledge bases and reasoning principles.

subtopics.title: Knowledge-based agents (TELL, ASK, KB architecture, Wumpus world environment)
Logic (Syntax, semantics, entailment, model checking, inference soundness and completeness)

topics.title: Propositional Logic
topics.description: Boolean logic syntax, semantics, and equivalence.

subtopics.title: Propositional logic (Syntax, semantics, truth tables, logical equivalence)
Propositional theorem proving (Inference rules, Modus Ponens, Resolution in PL, CNF conversion)
Agents based on propositional logic (Finding pits and wumpus with SAT reasoning)

topics.title: First-Order Predicate Logic (FOL)
topics.description: Objects, relations, functions, quantifiers and knowledge engineering.

subtopics.title: Syntax of First-Order Logic (Constants, variables, predicates, functions, quantifiers)
Semantics of First-Order Logic (Models, interpretations, truth values)
Using First-Order Logic (Universal & existential assertions, nested quantifiers)
Knowledge representation in First-Order Logic (Kinship domains, numbers, sets, lists)

topics.title: Inference in First-Order Logic
topics.description: Generalized Modus Ponens, unification, chaining, and resolution refutation.

subtopics.title: Propositional vs First-Order inference (Universal & Existential Instantiation, Skolemization)
Unification (Most General Unifier MGU algorithm)
Lifting (Generalized Modus Ponens GMP)
Forward chaining (Datalog forward chaining, efficiency issues, rete algorithm concept)
Backward chaining (Prolog-style logic programming, depth-first goal search)
Resolution (Converting FOL to CNF, resolution rule, proof by contradiction)

modules.title: Machine Learning
modules.description: Supervised learning concepts, Decision Tree induction (ID3/Entropy), Overfitting, Model evaluation, and Linear Models.

topics.title: Learning from examples
topics.description: Introduction to machine learning agent design and inductive learning hypothesis.

topics.title: Forms of learning
topics.description: Supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and reinforcement learning paradigms.

topics.title: Supervised learning
topics.description: Function approximation, training set, test set, hypothesis space, Ockham razor.

topics.title: Learning decision trees
topics.description: Decision tree representation, entropy, information gain, ID3 algorithm walkthrough with restaurant example.

topics.title: Generalization and overfitting
topics.description: Causes of overfitting, bias-variance tradeoff, tree pruning, validation sets, k-fold cross-validation.

topics.title: Evaluating and choosing the best hypothesis
topics.description: Confusion matrix, accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC curve.

topics.title: Regression and classification with linear models
topics.description: Univariate and multivariate linear regression, gradient descent, logistic regression, sigmoid activation, decision boundaries.

subjects.name: Biomedical Instrumentation
subjects.textbook: J. G. Webster, Medical Instrumentation: Application and Design
subjects.description: Comprehensive study of human physiological systems, bioelectric potentials, biopotential electrodes, ECG machines, cardiovascular measurements, EEG, EMG, therapeutic aids, modern imaging modalities, and electrical hospital safety.

modules.title: Introduction to Human Physiological System
modules.description: Human physiological systems, bioelectric potentials, resting & action potential generation, and bioelectric potential recordings.

topics.title: Physiological systems of the human body
topics.description: Overview of cardiovascular, nervous, respiratory, and muscular systems.

topics.title: Heart and cardiovascular system
topics.description: Gross anatomy of heart, cardiac chambers, blood flow, cardiac cycle, and electrical conduction.

topics.title: Anatomy of the nervous system
topics.description: Central nervous system (CNS), peripheral nervous system (PNS), neurons, synapses, and reflex arc.

topics.title: Physiology of the respiratory system
topics.description: Lungs, airways, gas exchange mechanics, alveolar diffusion, and regulation of respiration.

topics.title: Problems encountered in biomedical measurements
topics.description: Inaccessibility of signals, low signal-to-noise ratio, variability, transducer loading effects, motion artifacts.

topics.title: Sources of bioelectric potentials
topics.description: Cellular ionic concentrations (Na+, K+, Cl-), semipermeable membranes, and Nernst equation.

topics.title: Resting potential
topics.description: Electrochemical equilibrium, Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz equation, sodium-potassium ATPase pump.

topics.title: Action potential
topics.description: Depolarization threshold, all-or-none law, repolarization, hyperpolarization, absolute & relative refractory periods.

topics.title: Propagation of action potentials
topics.description: Unmyelinated continuous conduction vs myelinated saltatory conduction via Nodes of Ranvier.

topics.title: Examples of bioelectric potentials
topics.description: Diagnostic electrophysiological signals, typical amplitudes and frequency spectrum.

subtopics.title: Electrocardiogram (ECG)
Electroencephalogram (EEG)
Electromyogram (EMG)
Electroretinogram (ERG)
Electrooculogram (EOG)
Electrogastrogram (EGG)

modules.title: Biopotential Electrodes and ECG
modules.description: Electrode theory, electrode-electrolyte interface, half-cell potential, biopotential amplifiers, ECG leads, Einthoven triangle, and ECG machine architecture.

topics.title: Biopotential electrodes
topics.description: Electrode-electrolyte interface, charge transfer, polarizable vs non-polarizable electrodes (Ag/AgCl).

topics.title: Basic theory of electrodes
topics.description: Equivalent circuit model of electrode-skin interface, half-cell potential, motion artifact generation.

topics.title: Microelectrodes
topics.description: Metal microelectrodes, micropipette glass electrodes for intracellular potential measurement.

topics.title: Skin surface electrodes
topics.description: Immersion, suction cup, floating electrodes, flexible electrodes, disposable pre-gelled electrodes.

topics.title: Needle electrodes
topics.description: Subcutaneous, concentric needle, bipolar needle electrodes for localized EMG recordings.

topics.title: Biochemical transducers
topics.description: Reference electrodes (calomel, Ag/AgCl), pH electrode, pO2 Clark electrode, pCO2 Severinghaus electrode.

topics.title: Transducers for biomedical applications
topics.description: Displacement, pressure, temperature, photoelectric, and piezoelectric transducers in medicine.

topics.title: Instrumentation for clinical laboratories
topics.description: Spectrophotometers, automated biochemical analyzers, flame photometers.

topics.title: Biopotential amplifiers
topics.description: High CMRR, high input impedance, low-noise front-end clinical amplifiers.

subtopics.title: Instrumentation amplifiers (3-opamp design, CMRR derivation, gain formula)
Isolation amplifiers (Optical, transformer-coupled, capacitive patient isolation)
Chopper amplifiers (Low-drift modulation/demodulation for DC biomedical signals)

topics.title: Electrical conduction system of the heart
topics.description: Sinoatrial (SA) node, atrioventricular (AV) node, Bundle of His, bundle branches, Purkinje fibers.

topics.title: Electrocardiograph
topics.description: P-wave, QRS-complex, T-wave, PR interval, ST segment, QT interval clinical significance.

topics.title: ECG electrodes and leads
topics.description: Standard 12-lead system: bipolar limb leads (I, II, III), augmented unipolar leads (aVR, aVL, aVF), precordial chest leads (V1-V6).

topics.title: Einthoven's triangle
topics.description: Einthoven law, cardiac vector hypothesis, Wilson central terminal (WCT).

topics.title: ECG readout devices
topics.description: Thermal array recorders, digital displays, telemetry transmission, Holter monitor recording.

topics.title: ECG machine - block diagram
topics.description: Protection circuit, lead selector, pre-amplifier, driven right leg (DRL) circuit, bandpass filters, main amplifier, driver stage, power supply.

modules.title: Measurement of Blood Pressure, Blood Flow and Heart Sound
modules.description: Direct and indirect blood pressure measurements, electromagnetic & ultrasonic blood flowmeters, cardiac output, plethysmography, and phonocardiography.

topics.title: Measurement of blood pressure
topics.description: Systolic, diastolic, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and physiology of vascular resistance.

topics.title: Direct blood pressure measurement
topics.description: Catheter-tip pressure sensors, fluid-filled catheter manometers, hydraulic dynamic response.

topics.title: Indirect blood pressure measurement
topics.description: Sphygmomanometer cuff, Korotkoff sounds (phases 1 to 5), auscultatory method.

topics.title: Oscillometric measurement method
topics.description: Automated non-invasive blood pressure (NIBP), pressure pulse oscillations, peak envelope detection.

topics.title: Ultrasonic method of blood pressure measurement
topics.description: Doppler shift detection of arterial wall motion under cuff occlusive pressure.

topics.title: Measurement of blood flow
topics.description: Electromagnetic blood flowmeter (Faraday's law of induction) and Doppler ultrasound flowmeter.

topics.title: Measurement of cardiac output
topics.description: Indicator dilution method, dye dilution, thermodilution technique, Fick principle method.

topics.title: Plethysmography
topics.description: Measurement of organ/limb volume changes for peripheral vascular diagnosis.

subtopics.title: Photoelectric plethysmography (PPG transmission and reflection, pulse oximetry concept)
Impedance plethysmography (Four-electrode bioimpedance, Nyboer equation, deep vein thrombosis screening)

topics.title: Measurement of heart sounds
topics.description: First (S1, lub) and second (S2, dub) sounds, murmurs, third and fourth sounds origin.

topics.title: Phonocardiography
topics.description: Contact acoustic sensors, bandpass filtering, clinical PCG recording alongside ECG.

modules.title: Measurement of EEG, EMG and Respiratory Parameters; Therapeutic Aid
modules.description: EEG recording & 10-20 system, brain wave bands, EMG & nerve conduction velocity, spirometry, pacemakers, defibrillators, ventilators, dialysis, and lithotripsy.

topics.title: Electroencephalogram (EEG)
topics.description: Brain electrophysiology, electrode placements, and spectral characteristics.

subtopics.title: Neuronal communication (Postsynaptic potentials, pyramidal cells, cortical dipole layers)
EEG measurement (International 10-20 electrode placement system, reference points nasion & inion)
EEG recording (Unipolar, bipolar, average montage, artifact suppression)
EEG analysis (Delta <4Hz, Theta 4-8Hz, Alpha 8-13Hz, Beta 13-30Hz, Gamma >30Hz waveforms; epilepsy diagnosis)

topics.title: Electromyogram (EMG)
topics.description: Skeletal muscle motor unit action potentials and peripheral nerve testing.

subtopics.title: Muscle response (Motor unit action potential MUAP, recruitment, neuromuscular junction)
Nerve conduction velocity measurements (Stimulation, latency measurement, conduction calculation v = d/(t2-t1))
EMG measurements (Needle EMG, surface EMG, signal amplification and audio monitoring)

topics.title: Respiratory parameters
topics.description: Lung volumes, capacities, and ventilatory mechanics instrumentation.

subtopics.title: Spirometer (Water-sealed spirometer, dry rolling seal, pneumotachograph, FVC, FEV1)
Pneumograph (Impedance pneumography, chest expansion strain gauge, thermocouple nasal airflow)

topics.title: Therapeutic aids
topics.description: Critical medical therapeutic and life-support instrumentation.

subtopics.title: Cardiac pacemakers (Pacing modes: asynchronous fixed-rate, synchronous demand, ventricular inhibited VVI)
Internal pacemakers (Implantable pulse generator IPG, lithium iodine battery, endocardial leads)
External pacemakers (Temporary transthoracic / transcutaneous pacing systems)
Defibrillators (AC defibrillator, DC defibrillator with Lown waveform, monophasic vs biphasic truncated exponential, AEDs)
Ventilators (Volume-cycled, pressure-cycled, time-cycled positive pressure mechanical ventilators)
Heart-lung machine (Extracorporeal circulation, peristaltic blood pump, membrane oxygenator, heat exchanger)
Hemodialysis (Artificial kidney, dialyzer semipermeable membrane, dialysate concentrate, ultrafiltration)
Lithotripsy (Extracorporeal shock-wave lithotripsy ESWL, electrohydraulic / electromagnetic / piezoelectric acoustic shock focusing for renal calculi)
Infant incubators (Thermal regulation, radiant warmers, servo-controlled humidity and oxygenation)

modules.title: Advances in Radiological Imaging and Electrical Safety
modules.description: Diagnostic X-ray, CT scanning, MRI physics, ultrasound imaging, hospital electrical safety hazards, microshock vs macroshock, and telemedicine.

topics.title: X-rays
topics.description: Generation, interactions, diagnostic radiography, and surgical tools.

subtopics.title: Principles of X-ray generation (Coolidge tube, rotating anode, Bremsstrahlung & characteristic radiation, filtration)
Uses of X-rays (Skeletal, pulmonary, soft tissue radiography)
Diagnostic still-picture imaging (Screen-film radiography, flat-panel digital radiography)
Fluoroscopy (Real-time dynamic X-ray imaging, image intensifier tube optics)
Angiography (Radiopaque contrast agents, digital subtraction angiography DSA)
Endoscopy (Fiberoptic flexible endoscope, video endoscope, cold light illumination)
Diathermy (Shortwave, microwave, and surgical electrosurgery cutting/coagulation units)

topics.title: Computed Tomography (CT)
topics.description: Cross-sectional volumetric reconstruction and scanner generations.

subtopics.title: Basic principle (Radon transform, fan beam gantry, Hounsfield units, filtered back-projection reconstruction)

topics.title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)
topics.description: Nuclear magnetic resonance physics, RF excitation, and spatial encoding.

subtopics.title: Basic principle of MRI systems (Hydrogen proton spin precession, Larmor frequency, RF excitation, T1 longitudinal and T2 transverse relaxation, gradient magnetic coils)

topics.title: Nuclear medicine systems
topics.description: Gamma camera (Anger camera), scintillation crystals, collimators, PET and SPECT scanners.

topics.title: Radiation therapy
topics.description: Medical linear accelerators (LINAC), teletherapy, brachytherapy, beam collimation and treatment planning.

topics.title: Ultrasonic imaging systems
topics.description: Medical acoustic imaging modes and piezoelectric transducers.

subtopics.title: Introduction (Acoustic impedance matching, pulse-echo reflection principle, piezoelectric transducer arrays)
Basic working principle (A-scan ophthalmic, B-scan 2D cross-section, M-scan echocardiography, Doppler colour flow mapping)

topics.title: Electrical safety
topics.description: Electromedical safety standards, shock prevention, and grounding systems.

subtopics.title: Physiological effects of electric current (Perception threshold 1mA, let-go current 10-20mA, ventricular fibrillation 100mA, burns)
Shock hazards from electrical equipment (Macroshock cutaneous contact vs Microshock catheter cardiac contact down to 10-20 microamps, ground loop potentials, leakage currents)
Methods of accident prevention (Chassis grounding, isolated power systems IPS with line isolation monitors LIM, ground fault circuit interrupters GFCI, isolated patient leads)

topics.title: Introduction to telemedicine
topics.description: Store-and-forward vs real-time telemedicine, tele-radiology, tele-cardiology, medical data security and bandwidth requirements.

subjects.name: Security in Computing
subjects.textbook: William Stallings, Cryptography and Network Security: Principles and Practice
subjects.description: Comprehensive study of computer security architecture, classical ciphers, DES, AES, public key cryptosystems (RSA, ElGamal, ECC), cryptographic hash functions, HMAC, digital signatures, key management, intrusion detection, malware, and DDoS defenses.

modules.title: Basics of Security and Traditional Cryptosystems
modules.description: OSI security architecture, security services/mechanisms, symmetric cipher model, substitution and transposition ciphers.

topics.title: OSI Security Architecture
topics.description: ITU-T Recommendation X.800 framework for systematic security design.

subtopics.title: Security attacks (Passive attacks: release of message contents, traffic analysis; Active attacks: masquerade, replay, modification, denial of service)
Security services (Authentication, access control, data confidentiality, data integrity, non-repudiation, availability)
Security mechanisms (Encipherment, digital signature, access control, data integrity, authentication exchange, traffic padding, routing control, notarization)

topics.title: Cryptography vs Cryptanalysis
topics.description: Principles of making ciphers vs breaking ciphers; Kerckhoffs' principle and Shannon's secrecy.

topics.title: Classical encryption techniques
topics.description: Foundational concepts of confusion and diffusion, cryptanalytic attack models (ciphertext-only, known-plaintext, chosen-plaintext, chosen-ciphertext).

topics.title: Symmetric cipher model
topics.description: Plaintext, encryption algorithm, secret key, ciphertext, decryption algorithm, secrecy requirement.

topics.title: Substitution ciphers
topics.description: Replacing letters/symbols with other letters, numbers, or symbols.

subtopics.title: Monoalphabetic vs Polyalphabetic ciphers (Letter frequency analysis and polyalphabetic period detection)
Caesar cipher (Shift cipher modulo 26, mathematical encryption & decryption, brute-force analysis)
Affine cipher (Key pair (a, b) where gcd(a, 26)=1, encryption C=(aP+b) mod 26, modular inverse decryption)
Playfair cipher (5x5 matrix key generation, encryption rules for same row/column/rectangle, digraph security)
Vigenere cipher (Keyword repetition, Vigenere tableau, Kasiski method for key length discovery)
Hill cipher (Linear algebra matrix multiplication modulo 26, matrix invertibility requirement det(K) coprime to 26)

topics.title: Transposition ciphers
topics.description: Permuting plaintext positions without substituting characters.

subtopics.title: Keyless transposition (Rail fence cipher zigzag writing and reconstruction)
Keyed transposition (Row-column columnar transposition with numeric key order)
Double transposition (Sequential rectangular columnar transposition for resistance to frequency anagramming)

modules.title: Modern Symmetric Key Cryptosystems
modules.description: Feistel structure, Data Encryption Standard (DES), 3DES, Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), block cipher modes (ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB, CTR), and RC4.

topics.title: Symmetric key ciphers
topics.description: Shared secret model, key space size, computational security versus unconditional security.

topics.title: Block ciphers vs Stream ciphers
topics.description: Block processing (fixed n-bit blocks) vs continuous bit/byte keystream processing, error propagation characteristics.

topics.title: Block cipher components
topics.description: S-boxes (non-linear substitution), P-boxes (permutation), XOR, key mixing, round functions.

topics.title: Product ciphers
topics.description: Combining substitution, permutation, and arithmetic operations to achieve Shannon's confusion and diffusion.

topics.title: Feistel and Non-Feistel ciphers
topics.description: Feistel network structure (left/right split, round function F, reversibility without inverting F) vs SPN substitution-permutation networks.

topics.title: Data Encryption Standard (DES)
topics.description: 64-bit block, 56-bit key Feistel cipher with 16 rounds.

subtopics.title: DES structure (Initial permutation IP, 16 Feistel rounds, 32-bit swap, inverse initial permutation IP-1)
Key generation (64-bit key with 8 parity bits -> PC-1 56 bits -> 16 subkeys via circular left shifts and PC-2 48 bits)
Design criteria (S-box non-linearity, avalanche effect, strict avalanche criterion SAC)
Weaknesses (56-bit short key vulnerable to brute force, weak keys, semi-weak keys, complementation property)
Double DES (Meet-in-the-middle attack requiring 2^57 operations, why double encryption fails to double security)
Triple DES (3DES with two or three keys, EDE encrypt-decrypt-encrypt mode, effective 112 or 168-bit security)

topics.title: Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
topics.description: Rijndael SPN cipher with 128-bit block and 128/192/256-bit keys.

subtopics.title: Overall structure (128-bit 4x4 state matrix, 10 rounds for 128-bit key, round architecture)
Stages of encryption and decryption (SubBytes byte substitution in GF(2^8), ShiftRows circular shifts, MixColumns matrix multiplication in GF(2^8), AddRoundKey XOR, and inverse stages)
Key expansion (Generating 44 32-bit words for 10 rounds, RotWord, SubWord, Rcon round constants)

topics.title: Block cipher modes of operation
topics.description: Techniques to encrypt sequences of data blocks larger than cipher block size.

subtopics.title: Electronic Codebook Mode (ECB) (Independent block encryption, pattern leakage flaw)
Cipher Block Chaining Mode (CBC) (IV initialization vector, XOR with previous ciphertext, error propagation)
Cipher Feedback Mode (CFB) (Converts block cipher into self-synchronizing stream cipher, shift register)
Output Feedback Mode (OFB) (Synchronous stream cipher, keystream generation, no error propagation in plaintext)
Counter Mode (CTR) (Incrementing counter encryption, parallel encryption/decryption, random access)

topics.title: Stream ciphers
topics.description: Pseudorandom keystream generator XORed with plaintext bitwise.

subtopics.title: Stream cipher structure (Keystream generator state, period length, randomness criteria)
RC4 algorithm (Key Scheduling Algorithm KSA for S[0..255] permutation, Pseudo-Random Generation Algorithm PRGA)

modules.title: Public Key Cryptosystems
modules.description: Asymmetric cryptography, RSA, ElGamal, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC).

topics.title: Introduction to public key cryptosystems
topics.description: Asymmetric key pairs (public encryption key, private decryption key), solving symmetric key distribution.

topics.title: Principles of public key cryptosystems
topics.description: One-way trapdoor functions, mathematical hardness problems, computational infeasibility of key derivation.

topics.title: Applications
topics.description: Encryption/decryption (confidentiality), digital signatures (authenticity), and key exchange.

topics.title: Requirements
topics.description: Diffie and Hellman conditions for secure public-key systems.

topics.title: Conventional vs Public Key Cryptosystems
topics.description: Comparison of secret key size, computational speed, key distribution scalability, and security properties.

topics.title: RSA Cryptosystem
topics.description: Rivest-Shamir-Adleman algorithm based on integer factorization problem.

subtopics.title: RSA algorithm (Prime generation p and q, modulus n=pq, Euler totient phi(n)=(p-1)(q-1), public exponent e with gcd(e, phi(n))=1, private exponent d = e^-1 mod phi(n), encryption C=M^e mod n, decryption M=C^d mod n)
RSA security (Mathematical factoring attacks, chosen-ciphertext attacks, OAEP padding requirement)
Attacks on RSA (Factoring n, computing phi(n), timing attacks, common modulus attacks)

topics.title: ElGamal Cryptosystem
topics.description: Asymmetric cipher based on Discrete Logarithm Problem (DLP).

subtopics.title: ElGamal algorithm (Prime q, primitive root alpha, private key XA, public key YA = alpha^XA mod q, ephemeral key k, ciphertext pair (C1, C2), decryption M = C2*(C1^XA)^-1 mod q)

topics.title: Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange
topics.description: Establishing shared secret over insecure communication channel.

subtopics.title: Algorithm (Global parameters prime q and primitive root alpha, private keys XA and XB, public values YA=alpha^XA mod q and YB=alpha^XB mod q, shared secret K = YB^XA mod q = YA^XB mod q)
Man-in-the-middle attack (Active interception of public exchange, need for authenticated key exchange / certificates)

topics.title: Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC)
topics.description: Public key cryptography using abelian group of points on elliptic curves y^2 = x^3 + ax + b mod p.

subtopics.title: ElGamal ECC (Point addition, point doubling, base point G, private key n, public point P=nG, encryption and decryption)
Key exchange using ECC (ECDH Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman, equal security with much smaller key lengths compared to RSA)

modules.title: Message Integrity and Authentication
modules.description: Cryptographic hash functions, SHA-512, Message Authentication Codes (HMAC, CMAC), digital signatures (RSA, ElGamal, DSS).

topics.title: Hash functions
topics.description: One-way compression functions mapping variable-length messages to fixed-length digests.

subtopics.title: Security requirements (Preimage resistance / one-way, Second preimage resistance / weak collision, Collision resistance / strong collision, Birthday paradox attack on n/2 bits)
Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-512) (Message padding to multiple of 1024 bits, 80-round compression function, 64-bit words, step architecture, round constant addition)

topics.title: Message Authentication Code (MAC)
topics.description: Keyed authentication tags verifying message integrity and source identity.

subtopics.title: Requirements (Resistance against forgery without knowledge of secret key K)
Uses (Message integrity, sender authenticity, authentication tied to encryption)
Hash-based MAC (HMAC) (Structure: HMAC_K(M) = H((K+ XOR opad) || H((K+ XOR ipad) || M)), security proof, design goals)
Cipher-based MAC (CMAC) (NIST SP 800-38B, CBC-MAC modification with subkeys K1 and K2 for arbitrary-length messages)

topics.title: Digital signatures
topics.description: Non-repudiable asymmetric authentication mechanisms.

subtopics.title: Attacks on digital signatures (Total break, selective forgery, existential forgery)
Digital signature forgeries (Known-message and chosen-message attacks)
Requirements (Signature verification using public key, impossible to forge without private key, timestamping to prevent replay)
Direct digital signatures (Direct sender-to-recipient signing, vulnerability to compromised private key and validity repudiation)
Arbitrated digital signatures (Involving trusted arbitrator / timestamping authority TTP)
RSA digital signature (Signing S = M^d mod n, verification M = S^e mod n with cryptographic hash formatting)
ElGamal digital signature (Signing using ephemeral secret k with gcd(k, q-1)=1, signature pair (S1, S2), verification condition)
Digital Signature Standard (DSS / DSA) (FIPS PUB 186, SHA hashing with DSA algorithm, modular reduction mod p and mod q)

modules.title: Key Distribution and System Security
modules.description: Key management, symmetric/asymmetric key distribution, X.509 certificates, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), malware types & defenses, and DDoS attacks & countermeasures.

topics.title: Key management
topics.description: Key lifecycle, generation, storage, distribution, revocation, and hierarchical master/session keys.

topics.title: Distribution of secret keys
topics.description: Establishing symmetric keys securely between end entities.

subtopics.title: Using symmetric encryption (Key Distribution Center KDC, Needham-Schroeder protocol, Kerberos tickets)
Using asymmetric encryption (Public-key session key distribution, nonce exchanges against replay)

topics.title: Distribution of public keys
topics.description: Public announcement, publicly available directory, public-key authority (PKA), and Public-Key Certificates (CA, X.509 format).

topics.title: System security
topics.description: Host and network defenses against unauthorized intrusion.

subtopics.title: Intruders (Classes: masquerader, misfeasor, clandestine user; intruder patterns)
Intrusion detection techniques (Statistical anomaly detection, rule-based / signature-based detection, HIDS vs NIDS, honeypots)
Password management (Password vulnerabilities, password salts, hashing with salt, password aging, proactive password checking)

topics.title: Malicious software
topics.description: Taxonomy of computer viruses, worms, and countermeasures.

subtopics.title: Viruses (Virus phases: dormant, propagation, triggering, execution; virus classification: boot sector, file infector, macro, polymorphic, metamorphic)
Related threats (Worms, trojan horses, spyware, ransomware, keyloggers, rootkits, botnets)
Countermeasures (First to fourth generation antivirus techniques, heuristic scanning, behavioral blocking, sandboxing)

topics.title: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks
topics.description: Attacking system availability through coordinated zombie botnets.

subtopics.title: Types of DDoS attacks (Volumetric attacks: UDP/ICMP floods, amplified DNS/NTP reflection; Protocol attacks: SYN flood, Ping of Death; Application-layer attacks: HTTP GET/POST floods, Slowloris)
Countermeasures (Attack prevention: filtering spoofed IP, egress filtering; Attack detection: anomaly monitoring; Attack response: rate limiting, blackholing, traffic scrubbers, Anycast routing)
